newsitem.title: UK: Next advances amid bear squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Next advances amid bear squeeze.

text.p: Shares in UK retailer Next Plc advanced further into uncharted territory on Wednesday on what dealers characterised as a "classic bear squeeze."
By 1012 GMT, the shares were up 20-1/2p to 691, just one penny off their record peak reached earlier.
"There's not enough stock about. It's a classic bear squeeze," said one dealer. "Next is a quality performer in the sector and no one wants to sell."
"The stock has been rising ever since (Next) reported its results," another dealer noted.
The stock has climbed 95p, or about 16 percent, since the retailing group posted stronger than expected results for 1996 on March 26.
